ud5.1:4.1: “Here, sir, while I was upstairs in the royal longhouse together with Queen Mallikā, I said this to Queen Mallikā:
ud5.1:4.2: ‘Mallikā, is there anyone more dear to you than yourself?’
ud5.1:4.5: But is there anyone more dear to you than yourself?’
ud5.1:4.6: When she said this, sir, I said to Queen Mallikā:
ud5.1:4.7: ‘For me also, Mallikā, there’s no one.’
